title: Mini Horses in Greece Bring Joy to Sick, Disabled
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: A non-profit group in Greece uses small horses to provide pet therapy to sick and disabled people.
sentences.zh: 希腊的一个非营利团体利用小马向病人和残疾人提供宠物治疗。

sentences.en: But the organization is now considering its future after facing financial difficulties.
sentences.zh: 但该组织在面临财政困难后,目前正在考虑其未来。

sentences.en: The Associated Press (AP) recently met members of the group, called Gentle Carousel Greece.
sentences.zh: 美联社(美联社)最近会见了该团体的成员,称为Gentle Carousel希腊。

sentences.en: The animals are brought to hospitals and care centers to give joy to the sick or those suffering physical limitations.
sentences.zh: 动物被送到医院和护理中心,给病人或身体受限制的人带来快乐。

sentences.en: The horses are bred as miniature animals and stand about 72 centimeters tall.
sentences.zh: 马是作为迷你动物培育的 身高约72厘米

sentences.en: They are specially trained to provide comfort to disabled children, sick people, or older adults.
sentences.zh: 他们接受过特别培训,为残疾儿童、病人或老年人提供舒适。

sentences.en: One of the horses was recently brought to a school outside Athens for children with special needs.
sentences.zh: 其中一匹马最近被带到雅典以外的学校,供有特殊需要的儿童上学。

sentences.en: At the school, nine-year-old Josifina Topa Mazuch seemed drawn to a small, gray horse.
sentences.zh: 在学校,九岁的Josifina Topa Mazuch 似乎被一只灰色的小马吸引。

sentences.en: She ended up leading the animal down a school hallway.
sentences.zh: 她最后带领动物 下到学校的走廊。

sentences.en: The horse, named Ivy, stood no taller than the girl’s pink wheelchair. “I really want them to come again,” Josifina told the AP about Ivy and another visiting horse, Calypso. “They made me feel really happy,” she added.
sentences.zh: 这匹叫Ivy的马没有那女孩的粉色轮椅高。 “我真的希望她们能再来, ” Josifina告诉AP关于Ivy和另一匹拜访马Calypso。 她补充说, “ 他们让我感到非常快乐, ” 。

sentences.en: Ivy and Calypso are two of nine miniature horses provided by the non-profit group.
sentences.zh: Ivy和Calypso是非营利团体提供的九匹小型马中的两匹。

sentences.en: The organization is linked to an American group called Gentle Carousel Miniature Therapy Horses.
sentences.zh: 该组织与一个美国团体有联系,称为 " 轻巧的卡鲁塞尔微型治疗马 " 。

sentences.en: The U.S. group is based in Ocala, Florida.
sentences.zh: 美国集团设在佛罗里达的奥卡拉。

sentences.en: The organization said the horses complete at least two years of training.
sentences.zh: 该组织说,这些马至少完成了两年的训练。

sentences.en: They are taught how to work in confined environments with children and adults with special health needs.
sentences.zh: 教育他们如何在封闭的环境中与具有特殊健康需要的儿童和成年人一起工作。

sentences.en: Caregivers say the horses provide a form of pet therapy that offers valuable social interactions and new learning experiences.
sentences.zh: 照顾者说马提供一种宠物疗法,提供宝贵的社会互动和新的学习经验。

sentences.en: But the leader of the Greek organization says her group has been financially struggling in recent years.
sentences.zh: 但希腊组织的领导人说,她的团体近年来一直在财政上挣扎。

sentences.en: Gentle Carousel Greece is run by 68-year-old Mina Karagianni.
sentences.zh: 温柔的希腊卡鲁塞尔由68岁的卡拉吉安尼经营

sentences.en: She said she now performs most of the group’s duties herself.
sentences.zh: 她说,她现在亲自履行小组的大部分职责。

sentences.en: Karagianni also finances the group and cares for the nine miniature horses, mostly by herself.
sentences.zh: Karagianni也资助这个团体, 并照顾九匹迷你马,

sentences.en: Karagianni also told the AP she learned about the Florida-based organization over the internet while she was searching for information on a pony she had rescued.
sentences.zh: Karagianni还告诉AP,她通过互联网了解了设在佛罗里达的组织的情况,当时她正在寻找她所拯救的一匹小马的信息。

sentences.en: After learning about the group’s activities, she got the idea to start her own operation.
sentences.zh: 在了解了该团体的活动后,她有了自己开始行动的想法。

sentences.en: “I was touched and I was moved, and I said: ‘OK, we have to bring this to Greece,’” Karagianni said.
sentences.zh: “我被感动,我被感动,我说,“好吧,我们必须把这个带回希腊。” Karagianni说。

sentences.en: So, she decided to make changes to her land to be able to care for the horses.
sentences.zh: 所以她决定改变土地 来照顾马匹

sentences.en: She said she turned her property into what she calls a “Magic Garden.” She has everything she needs to care for the horses.
sentences.zh: 她说,她把她的财产变成了一个她称之为“Magic Garden”的财产。 她拥有她需要照顾的马匹。

sentences.en: She also runs a small restaurant and party area.
sentences.zh: 她还经营一个小餐馆和聚会区。

sentences.en: Karagianni launched her Greek group in 2014.
sentences.zh: Karagianni于2014年成立希腊团体。

sentences.en: She said the organization has served about 12,000 children since it began until the pandemic led to restrictions in 2020.
sentences.zh: 她说,该组织自开始为大约12 000名儿童提供服务,直到该流行病在2020年导致限制。

sentences.en: The pandemic caused financial pressures and Karagianni herself faced a medical problem that hurt her ability to run the group. “I’m just starting to get myself back together again now,” she told the AP. “With a lot of financial difficulties.
sentences.zh: 这一流行病造成了财政压力,卡拉吉安尼本人也面临着医疗问题,这损害了她管理这一群体的能力。 “我刚刚开始重新振作起来, ” 她告诉AP : “ 财政困难重重。 ”

sentences.en: But what can I do? I’m trying.” Karagianni said she had contacted businesses and non-profit groups about financial help but has not been successful.
sentences.zh: Karagianni说,她已经与企业和非营利团体联系,寻求资金帮助,但一直没有成功。

sentences.en: She plans to continue to seek help. “I’m making super-human efforts,” Karagianni said. “I’m doing what I can.
sentences.zh: 她打算继续寻求帮助。 卡拉吉安尼说 : “ 我正在做出超人的努力。 ”卡拉吉安尼说 : “ 我正在尽我所能。 ”

sentences.en: But I can’t do it alone,” she added. Karagianni said she keeps going because she sees the great benefits the children and adults receive from the animals.
sentences.zh: 卡拉甘尼(Karagianni)说她继续走是因为她看到了动物给儿童和成年人带来的巨大好处。

sentences.en: At the special needs school, teacher Eleni Volikaki said she sees “incredible” reactions from the children. “It’s like something awakens their senses.” Volikaki noted the horses can often get students to make more progress than with other therapy methods.
sentences.zh: 在特殊需要学校,Eleni Volikaki老师说,她认为孩子们的反应是“不可相信的 ” 。 “这就像某种东西唤醒了他们的感官。 ”Volikaki指出,马往往能让学生比其他治疗方法取得更大的进步。

sentences.en: “We saw things we didn’t expect,” she said. “We saw children with autism, or children who are generally afraid of animals, coming very close, letting the (horses) get close to them.” Volikaki added.
sentences.zh: 她说 : “ 我们看到了一些我们没有预料到的事情。 ”我们看到了自闭症儿童,或者一般害怕动物的儿童,他们走得非常近,让(马)靠近他们。 ”

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn. The Associated Press reported this story.
sentences.zh: 我是Bryan Lynn, 美联社报导了这个故事。

sentences.en: Bryan Lynn adapted the report for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Bryan Lynn改编了VOA学习英语的报告。
